# Railtracks Docs

> Railtracks is a Python framework for building agents and harnesses: the loop, tools, context, and controls around an LLM.

Each link below is a clean Markdown copy of one docs page. llms-full.txt holds every page in a single file.

## Home

- [Home](https://docs.railtracks.org/index.md)
